System: [LaNd](Cr0.2Mn0.2Fe0.2Co0.2Ni0.2)O3 perovskites. Processing: solid-state reactions, with initial components mixed in stoichiometric proportions, ground for 3 h, compacted at 3 tons/cm2, and heated at 1300 °C for 10 h. Test conditions: temperatures of 150-450 K, frequencies of 10−1-107 Hz, and magnetic fields of ±3T.
